# SpacePilot

> SpacePilot compiles intent into cinema.

SpacePilot is a generative cinema runtime by the MotionVector program
(motionvector.dev). It runs open-weight video and audio models directly on GPUs
you control — local or cloud — and is directed through code, UI, or MCP tools,
serving human directors and AI agents alike.

## Status

In private development. The public surface is this waitlist page:
https://spacepilot.dev — join for early access. Runtime documentation is
internal.

## Related

- MotionVector agentic video studio: https://motionvector.dev
